capability_name: God's Eye View Airspace Aircraft Tracking Capability
purpose: Provide near real-time spatial positioning, kinematic monitoring, and situational awareness for commercial and general aviation aircraft within monitored airspace sectors.

source_dataset_reference.data_licence: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) v1.0

inputs.name: center_latitude
inputs.description: Geographic center point latitude in decimal degrees [-90.0, 90.0]

inputs.name: center_longitude
inputs.description: Geographic center point longitude in decimal degrees [-180.0, 180.0]

inputs.name: search_radius_nm
inputs.description: Observation radius around center in nautical miles [1, 250]

inputs.name: filter_hex_id
inputs.description: Optional filter for specific 24-bit ICAO aircraft hex identifier

inputs.name: filter_callsign
inputs.description: Optional filter for specific commercial flight callsign prefix

outputs.name: aircraft_state_vectors
outputs.description: Array of normalized aircraft observations matching schema defined in dataset_record.json

outputs.name: query_metadata
outputs.description: Execution timestamp, observation count, and query bounding parameters

freshness_characteristics.typical_latency_seconds: < 1.5s from radio broadcast reception to normalized record output
freshness_characteristics.observation_age_metrics: Monitored via 'seen' and 'seen_pos' sensor age attributes

limitations: VHF Radio Line-of-Sight: Target aircraft below radar/SDR horizon or masked by terrain cannot report positions.
Feeder Infrastructure Availability: Relies on community SDR ground receiver uptime.
Transponder Dependency: Excludes military stealth or unequipped general aviation aircraft lacking Mode-S/ADS-B transponders.
possible_bhiv_consumers: Flight Route Deviation & Anomaly Detection Agent
Urban Air Mobility (UAM) Corridor Monitoring Agent
dependencies: adsb.lol REST API v2 network connectivity
BHIV MasterDB authorization and service bus routing (PENDING)
